senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כָּשַׁל)a carpenter’s tool for chipping, axe.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:10">B. Kam. X, 10</cite> <he>ובכ׳ של בעה״ב</he> when working with the axe, the chips belong to the owner, contrad. to <cite ref="M02159"><he>מעצד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite> <he>כ׳ של ברזל</he> iron axes (as a weapon in war).
